name: io.github.tonyyang0504/mercedes_benz_gebrauchtwagen-mcp
description: Mercedes-Benz Vehicle Specification (automotive): decode_vin. Every tool maps to a documented endpoi

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCEDES_BENZ_GEBRAUCHTWAGEN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Secret API key of a Mercedes-Benz /developers console project subscribed to Vehicle Specification (commercial plan); sent as x-api-key.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MERCEDES_BENZ_GEBRAUCHTWAGEN_LOCALE
environmentVariables.description: Market locale for descriptions, e.g. de_DE or en_GB (required by the API; only some locales are supported).
